name: Dashboard
description: What needs you, what your agents did, and how each project is doing.
author: Vicoa

needsLabel.title: Needs-you label
needsLabel.description: Open tasks with this label are listed under Needs you.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Project keys or names to show, in order, one per line. Leave empty to show every project with open work, recent runs or a snapshot.

lanes.title: Automation columns
lanes.description: Which column each automation's runs go in, by automation id: "build", "growth" or "ops". Easier to set from a project page.

runsScope.title: Agent runs
runsScope.description: Show only runs started by automations, or every session.
